configuration_scope: test inputs only; production thresholds must be supplied from device evaluation
propagation: world_from_scan retains the visual alignment; camera_from_scan is inverse(world_from_camera)*world_from_scan and is valid only under propagated_pose_valid; raw_pose_valid remains false
result_age_scope: host checks submit/delivery time against capture time; Session update has no host-now argument and does not guess a clock epoch
residuals: relative translation norm and SO(3) rotation angle are checked separately, invariant under a rigid change of world origin
smoothing: alpha=1-exp(-accepted_capture_delta_seconds/tau), linear translation and shortest-arc SO(3) interpolation; tau=0 disables smoothing
bootstrap_and_recovery: Before alignment is ready, an inconsistent candidate restarts the window with that candidate as its seed; only the configured number of subsequent mutually consistent candidate samples publishes alignment. An inconsistent sample never replaces an established alignment.
reset_epoch: An explicit reset pins generation and tracking epoch; any mismatched epoch is rejected before touching current alignment, including late old tracking samples with a newer valid Raw frame.
